text: Factual correction: the engine scale is 0-3, so 'intensity 4' maps onto nothing here; Brave Bora's peak would be our intensity 3 (fear), which BeatSequenceValidator rejects with intensityCeiling=2 in every band, not only 5-6. A narrower version is already possible without touching the ceiling: intensity-2 states (unease, hesitation, concern) followed by an adult-reassurance beat, within the existing rule of at most two consecutive intensity-2 pages. Raising the ceiling on one book is not justified, and any ceiling change is a privacy-safety decision before it is an engine one.
